name: Calculus Time
author: LaughingFox
description:
A time travelling deckbuilder to practice basic calculus skills. 

Development info:

This game was developed as part of the scholarship project # 23E-ISAU-MS-01 sponsored by the Centre for Scholarship and Innovation in Science, Technology, Engineering and Maths (eSTEeM), the Open University, UK.
